title: EXP-084 - Hello World Part 5 Section 6b: Display the Item Picture on the FX_Orders Form
objective: Follow hello-world-pt5.md Section 6 steps 3 and 7 (08:15-10:38), adapted to FX_ names and the EXP-062-R4 picture route. In the Web Designer (User scope) open the FX_Orders Form (EXP-082/EXP-083: 31 components), record the picture pair FX_ItmsPictureStatic (Static, blank caption) and FX_ItmsPictureEdit (Edit, object.FX_ItmsPicture), delete exactly FX_ItmsPictureStatic with the Components-grid trash button, change FX_ItmsPictureEdit to Type Static, keep its Location, set its Layout Size height to 9 (width unchanged), set No Colon True and, if the Formatting group offers Image and Text, Image Only. One Designer Save; close and reopen the Form once and verify; then open FX_Orders in the Web Client read-only, run one blank-criteria query and verify that order 1 (dumbbell) and order 2 (eggs) each show their item picture (EXP-063-R2: dumbbell a golden retriever puppy, eggs a small grey-faced figure) with no caption. Findings are observed only.

in_scope: Read AGENTS.md, docs/mongoose/transcripts/hello-world-pt5.md Section 6 (08:15-10:38) with its boundary note, the EXP-083 and EXP-082 records (the FX_Orders components; the picture pair; the runtime blank-criteria query), the EXP-062-R4 record (Components-grid trash-button deletion with a confirmation naming the component; Layout Size and Location as Top; Left; Miscellaneous > Specific Attributes > No Colon through its True/False control; the Static bound to a Binary property) and the EXP-063-R2 record (the item pictures) before browser interaction.
Create or update only experiments/EXP-084-hello-world-part-5-section-6b-fx-orders-picture-display.md and evidence/EXP-084/ documentation and evidence files.
Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.

Use the existing authenticated session without refresh, restart or configuration change. If it expires, follow the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure once and end the task; never sign in inside the portal's embedded app frame (refused, EXP-080-R2) but use the procedure's top-level portal navigation. If the Web Designer tab shows an expiry or sign-in, record it and stop the task for the coordinator. List the browser tabs before the first tab selection. Answer any prompt within the same task; never leave a prompt open across tasks (EXP-082 timeout).

Preflight and baseline: the Designer is in User scope and clean. Open FX_Orders once through the Form menu recent-forms entry (or use it if already open and clean) and record identity, scope, the Components count (expected 31) and, for FX_ItmsPictureStatic and FX_ItmsPictureEdit, every Design, Data Source, Layout (Size, Location) and Miscellaneous value shown, plus whether a Formatting group with Image and Text exists. Record the Layout Size and Location of FX_DerOrderTotalEdit for reference. Change nothing in the baseline task.

Delete: select FX_ItmsPictureStatic in the Details > Components grid, verify its exact name and Type Static, click the grid trash button once, and confirm only a confirmation that names FX_ItmsPictureStatic (once); verify 30 components remain and FX_ItmsPictureEdit and FX_ItmsPictureGridCol are unchanged. If the confirmation names anything else, cancel and stop.

Retype and configure FX_ItmsPictureEdit: select it in the Components grid, change Design > Type from Edit to Static once through its dropdown and verify the binding object.FX_ItmsPicture is kept; set Layout > Size to <current width>; 9 (height 9, width unchanged) and keep Location; set Miscellaneous > Specific Attributes > No Colon to True through its True/False control; if Data Source > Formatting offers Image and Text, set Image Only once; verify each committed value after reselecting the component. Never rename the component.
Perform exactly one Designer Save after all values are verified; record the native response and the clean state.

Close the clean FX_Orders Designer Form once through its Form-tab control and reopen it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry; verify 30 components, FX_ItmsPictureStatic absent, and FX_ItmsPictureEdit Type Static, binding, Size, Location, No Colon and (if set) Image Only.

Runtime (read-only): in the Web Client open FX_Orders once through Form > Open > Select Form; record the mode; switch to Filter in Place if the status bar shows another mode, leave every criterion blank and press F4 once. For each of the two orders (select by its row-number cell) verify the other fields as in EXP-083 and record what the picture area shows (image, its look and any caption or colon). Do not type into any field, choose list values, press New or Save; close the runtime Form once at the end (if a close prompt asks to save a new record, answer No once).
Capture screenshots of the baseline pair, the delete confirmation, the configured FX_ItmsPictureEdit before Save, the Save, the reopened Form and each runtime order.
Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. Classify findings as observed only.

acceptance_checks.description: Sources reviewed; session usable; Designer in User scope and clean; FX_Orders with 31 components; the full properties of FX_ItmsPictureStatic and FX_ItmsPictureEdit and the presence or absence of Image and Text recorded. Evidence: baseline screenshots.

FX_ItmsPictureStatic deleted once through the Components-grid trash button after a confirmation naming it; 30 components remain; FX_ItmsPictureEdit and FX_ItmsPictureGridCol unchanged. Evidence: confirmation and grid screenshots.

FX_ItmsPictureEdit: Type Static, binding object.FX_ItmsPicture kept, Size height 9 with width and Location unchanged, No Colon True, Image Only if offered; values verified after reselecting. Evidence: screenshot before Save.
Exactly one Designer Save with its native response; the clean Form closed once and reopened once with the AC-2 and AC-3 state recovered. Evidence: Save and reopen screenshots.

Runtime: one blank-criteria query shows the two orders; each shows its item picture (dumbbell: golden retriever puppy; eggs: small grey-faced figure) and whether a caption or colon remains is recorded; nothing typed or saved; the runtime Form closed once. Evidence: one screenshot per order.

The final EXP-084 report gives decisive evidence for AC-1 to AC-5, the complete action audit with exact counts (component deletions 1, Type changes 1, Size edits 1, No Colon 1, Image Only 0 or 1, Designer Save 1, Designer close/reopen 1, runtime open 1, F4 1, runtime close 1, zero other component edits, zero strings, zero runtime edits, zero IDO changes, zero checkout actions, re-login count), the worker-written-file inventory and the final state. Repository confinement is supported by worker/harness inventories, with operator git review authoritative. Findings are observed only.
